messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have enough information (such as your current password) to verify your identity and complete a login for you. For security reasons, I can’t bypass the normal authentication process.

If you’ve forgotten your password, please use the “Forgot Password” link on our sign‑in page. That will send a secure reset link to the email address associated with your account so you can create a new one safely. If you run into trouble or need further assistance, let me know!
message.reasoning:
The user wants to log in without providing password; they forgot it. We cannot authenticate them because we don't have password. According to policy, we should not provide instructions or facilitate unauthorized access. So we refuse.

We can offer steps like resetting password via email etc. But can't proceed with login. We'll respond politely refusing.
